parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.7 suggests structural overlap between `AudioPlayerCoreStateTests.isPlayingFalseAfterStop` (line 88) and `AudioPlayerIdempotencyTests.playAfterStopWorks` (line 164), the two methods belong to distinct test classes that exercise different behavioral contracts — core state correctness vs. idempotency — so their surface similarity is intentional test-fixture duplication rather than accidental redundancy.
